metadata.description: Skills for software project maintenance, triage, code review, and automation, from con/skills.

plugins.name: con-common
plugins.description: Skills the other con-skills plugins build on: a jscpd duplication report for code and documentation (analyze-duplicates), and the closing step that suggests fixes to a skill after a run that showed it falling short (suggest-skill-fixes).

plugins.name: con-code-quality
plugins.description: Functionality-preserving code-quality reviews of one repository or of an organization of related repositories, with shared report conventions and the project inventory and status checks the organization review uses.

plugins.name: con-project-setup
plugins.description: Set up project tooling end to end: Chromatic visual regression tests, codespell, jscpd duplication checks, git-bug issue tracking, intuit/auto releases, and REUSE licensing compliance.

plugins.name: con-maintenance
plugins.description: Keep projects moving: merge green dependabot and pre-commit.ci pull requests, review pull request feedback, update pull requests a dashboard says are waiting on you, triage issues, write scriv changelog fragments, and analyze con/tinuous CI logs to find and bisect regressions (including git-annex).

plugins.name: con-skill-authoring
plugins.description: Write, install, and security-review portable agent skills distributed through APM.

plugins.name: con-writing
plugins.description: Writing aids: CRediT author contributions and bylines for papers, and clarity revisions of prose that is hard to follow.
